rules.text: requirements/RFP/brief documents are intent, not state: they live in the questions ledger, never as tracked files

every Multisim binary this goal touches is the one production binary the desktop launcher starts (same Wine prefix ~/.multisim143, same multisim.exe); any second prefix or parallel install is a violation

every verification goes through multisim-mcp's own COM worker protocol (the production path the MCP frontend uses); a hand-rolled parallel COM client that re-verifies what the MCP stack already exercises is an orthogonal test and forbidden
